name: Blue Chip India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Blue Chip India Ltd is in the business of fund-based activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
BCIL used to be a Non-Banking Financial Company and was mainly engaged in granting 
of Loans and Advances and Investment in Shares & Securities. The company's NBFC licence was cancelled in FY19, and currently, it is engaged in investments and fund-based activities.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.23% over last 3 years.
